summary.en: The pipeline spans neurology, immune disease and oncology, mixing in-house research with licensed antibodies. Late-stage regional filings sit alongside earlier discovery programs.
summary.zh: 管线涵盖神经科学、免疫疾病和肿瘤,将自主研究与许可的抗体相结合。后期区域性申报与较早期的发现项目并存。
